name: DAVIDsTEA
description: Canadian tea brand with an online store selling loose-leaf tea, matcha, teaware, gifts and advent calendars. The site offers Canada and United States selectors in English and French, with free shipping over 75 dollars and a flat rate under that.
description_es: Marca canadiense de té con tienda en línea de té en hojas, matcha, accesorios, regalos y calendarios de adviento. El sitio ofrece selectores de Canadá y Estados Unidos en inglés y francés, con envío gratis sobre 75 dólares y tarifa fija por debajo.

ships_to.notes: Free shipping on orders over 75 dollars, flat rate 8.99 dollars otherwise; orders are processed within 48 hours.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: A store locator exists; pickup of online orders is not stated on the shipping page.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: shipping thresholds and flat rate, Canada and US region selector, English and French
